data: What is the highest miss probability shown by any FFN or ResNet

The question asks for the highest miss probability shown by any FFN or ResNet. From the caption, we know that the figure shows DET curves for monolingual and multilingual features estimated using FFNs and ResNets for T1 queries of QUESST 2014. The y-axis represents the miss probability in percentage, and the x-axis represents the false alarm probability in percentage. 

Looking at the figure, the highest miss probability appears to be around 60%. This can be verified by observing the topmost curve on the graph, which corresponds to the FFN: PT feature. The curve starts at approximately 60% and decreases as the false alarm probability increases. Therefore, the highest miss probability shown by any FFN or ResNet is approximately 60%.
